title: Displacement
text: Displacement is the integral of velocity v(t). Total distance traveled is the integral of the speed $$|v\left(t\right)|$$.

title: Check the sign of v
text: $$v(t)=\left(t-6\right) \left(t+3\right)$$ is negative or zero on [0,6], so the speed is $$-v(t)$$ and the distance is $$90$$.
